_comment: Accepted dependency advisories. Each entry needs id (GHSA/CVE), scope, reason and an expiry date; expired entries fail the audit. Only high/critical findings need an exception (moderate/low are reported, not blocking).

exceptions.reason: launch-editor reached via vite, a transitive dependency of vitepress 1.6.4 (docs build only). The vulnerable code is the dev server (launch-editor, Windows path check), which is never run or deployed; CI builds the static site on Linux. No fix reachable without a vitepress major upgrade. The other vite/esbuild advisories in this tree are below the blocking threshold (moderate/low).
